description: A gold eye with a black slit, dry now. Emberjaw and its pale cousin both look at you out of these.
lore: It comes out with the rim of skin still round it, because the eye on its own fetches half. The skin is the paper the sale is written on. Crusted, split, a seam of light gone dark in the crack, and it is off [[monsters/lava_salamander|the basking one]] at the near end of the black rock. Olive going grey, dry, wrinkled flat, and it is off [[monsters/lava_salamander_2|the other]], which works ground a great deal closer to the mountain.

So the eye prices the seller, not itself. There is a buyer at that end of the market who pays a shade over for the olive ones and keeps the tally in his head, and he knows to the month which crackers are still going out that far and which have quietly stopped. He has never said what the tally is for. He has twice sent somebody to sit at a crossing and wait for a man who was late.
gm_notes: Two creatures, one eye, and the socket skin is the provenance. The buyer's ledger is the eastern ground's only attendance register; he will not call it care and it is.
